title: Error codes
spec: SPEC.md section 6 (the table of codes) and sections 4 to 16
note: `codes` is the complete list of SPEC 6, in the order of the table, with where the spec uses each.

codes.where: 4: invalid JSON, unknown t, missing field
16 no common version
5 failed hello, surface key required, key confirmation failed, transcript not well-formed
5 origin not allowed for an agent credential or on the surface allowlist; surface url of another origin; 3 a surface on a socket that takes agents only
4 oversize frame; 9 act result over 32 KiB; 12 consent arguments too large
6 and 16 unknown method
6 params nested too deeply; 9 unknown action, args fail the schema, a chat text or note out of bounds; 12 a chat `to` that names no other agent that hears the speaker
6 unknown surface id, or one the credential may not attach to
8 no live grant
8 empty scope intersection, grant lacks scope, scope switched off by the person
5 manifest pin; 8 attach deny; 9 act deny, private target, nav, stream.open without coordinates; 12 a chat `to` from an agent that no other agent hears
8 attach refused; 9 act refused; 12 third refusal revokes, the person's rule deny
6 a request that waits for the person's answer (0.2); 16 sent to an agent on 0.1 as E_CONSENT
9 pause; 12 indicator not usable, the person keeps using the page
8 attach burst; 11 pointer rate; 12 cool-off; 13 token buckets and admission
9 disabled, unknown, detached, unexposed or read-only target
6 request timeout
6 surface disconnected with requests pending

5 more than 16 pending handshakes; 8 attach in flight, more than 32 grants on a surface; 9 prompt up (chat.say and chat.status included), a permission that changed while the request waited; 12 prompts; 13 capacity, a peer that does not read
9 handler threw, result not JSON; 13 audit unavailable
